name: B10-0058/2025 (S&D) – Need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It calls for an end to the repression in Belarus and for the release of all political prisoners. It says the EU will not recognise the election planned for 26 January 2025 or Lukashenka as president. It asks the EU to widen sanctions and to keep supporting Belarusian democratic groups and independent media.

- The EU is asked to widen sanctions on officials tied to repression and election fraud.
- Political prisoners and their families should get visa help, monitoring and support.
- The EU will not recognise the January 2025 election or Lukashenka's rule.
